summary: Iteration 27 — Items 2-6 (invoice action row, PO edit/cancel/restore, shops/accounts/team edit+dormant, invoice templates receipt vs A4). Backend: 9/9 pytest pass covering PO lifecycle (create 1 → stock +1; edit 1→2 nets exactly +1, not +2; cancel reverses to 0 and drops supplier owed by 2000; 2nd cancel 400; PUT on cancelled 400; PUT empty lines 422; uncancel restores stock), shops rename+dormant (main branch 400, dormant removed from pickers, POST /shops/active on dormant 403, reopen works), accounts edit+dormant (PUT works, dormant toggles, only-live rule 400, dormant still appears with balance), team edit+dormant (PUT name/phone passthrough, dormant → login 403 'This account is dormant...', reinstate → login 200, owner self-dormant 400). Frontend verified end-to-end on the public URL: /invoices/{id} shows all three states (draft → invoice-record-payment + invoice-issue-shortcut, unpaid → invoice-record-payment + no shortcut, paid → invoice-record-payment='Record another payment' + invoice-paid-note); /purchases/{id} live shows purchase-edit + purchase-cancel, cancelled shows purchase-restore + purchase-cancelled-note + Cancelled badge, purchase-edit routes to /purchases/new?edit=<id> with header 'Edit purchase' and 'Save the correction' button, purchase-cancel-sheet renders purchase-cancel-reason + purchase-cancel-confirm; /shops exposes shop-edit-Ikeja branch and shop-edit-Surulere, both route to /shops/new?edit=<name> with name/address/phone/sells prefilled and shop-dormant button; /accounts account-edit-<id> opens account-add-sheet with kind tabs prefilled + Save changes + account-dormant; /settings/invoice-template exposes templates-current (reads 'Now using Template N'), templates-pick-t1..t7, templates-save, and selecting t1 then Save then full reload PERSISTS as 'Template 1' — restored demo to Template 3 as teardown; chips 'Counter receipt · 80mm' and 'Full A4 invoice' present; /invoices/pdf/{id} Simple tab renders paper-receipt (narrow 80mm paper, shop name CAPS, dashed rules, qty×price, TOTAL, thank-you, NO image column, NO bank block) and Professional tab renders full A4 invoice (dark item table with Qty/Rate/Discount/Amount columns, business + branch + TIN block); Download + Share both visible on both tabs. No React Native issues, no deprecated packages, no red screens, no console errors beyond the known style.resizeMode deprecation warning (not fatal). Teardown clean: amina@tredi.app can log in (verified HTTP 200), no accounts/shops dormant, demo tenant on plan pro/monthly/NGN with Ikeja branch main, Template 3 restored. Note on prior iterations: three TEST shops created across sessions (TEST shop 4cacd4 renamed, TEST shop 64c583 renamed, TEST shop 48b7e9) remain in the business doc because the API has no DELETE for shops by design — spec says shops are never deleted — they are all non-dormant and empty, matching the rule. One cancelled TEST purchase (PO-449) was also created during the backend test and left cancelled by the teardown step so stock is untouched.

issues: Direct URL /purchases returns 'Unmatched Route — Page could not be found'. Purchases are reached through /suppliers/<id> instead. The spec does not require a /purchases list screen (only /purchases/{id} and /purchases/new), so this is just a stale deep-link rather than a bug — worth noting in case a nav tile or email links to /purchases.

Simple tab's till receipt renders a placeholder TIN like 'TIN 1234567-0001' and a hard-coded 'TREDI VENTURES' / '12 Test Road, Ikeja' header which comes straight from the demo seed, so this is correct — only noting it so the next agent does not mistake it for a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/purchases.py update_purchase: the old lines are reversed first and then the new lines applied, so edit 1→2 nets +1 correctly. If apply_stock throws mid-loop the order sits half-reversed; same multi-doc caveat as sale edit, acceptable for the SMB target.

routes/purchases.py cancel_purchase: $set only on cancelled_at/by/reason — the paid field is left untouched, so supplier_owed uses LIVE_PO to filter cancelled POs out of the owed sum (verified: owed drops by exactly the PO total). supplier_payments against a cancelled PO still sit on the supplier record which is correct — a paid cancelled PO already took money out and is now a credit note on the supplier.

routes/shops.py set_shop_dormant: 'last working shop' guard checks `sum(... not s.get('dormant')) <= 1` BEFORE flipping, so an owner with Ikeja + Surulere + one TEST shop can dormant two of them but not the last one. If the main branch is somehow non-main (edited `is_main: false`) the only-main-can-stand rule can still race — in practice is_main is set at creation and not editable from the UI, so fine.

routes/users_roles.py set_member_dormant: writes `active: false/true`, and login() rejects `active == False` with 403 'This account is dormant...'. Reinstate flips `active: true` and login succeeds (verified end-to-end).

server.py update_account: writes AccountIn fields over the row — opening_balance edit is kept but no recomputation of statement is forced since balances are computed on the fly from entries, so the new opening_balance takes effect on next GET. Good.

frontend/app/settings/invoice-template.tsx: templates-pick-tN sets the pending selection, templates-save POSTs settings/invoice-template and the reload survives the choice (confirmed via the public URL). Default export chips (receipt vs A4) are a separate preference and persist too.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all items 2-6 verified on the public URL)

seed_data_creation: One throwaway supplier PO was created on the owner tenant (qty 1 → 2 of the first demo item), cancelled as teardown so stock is back to the pre-test level. The accounts/shops/team dormant tests toggled dormant on/off and reinstated every subject. amina@tredi.app re-login verified HTTP 200. Templates were toggled from Template 3 → Template 1 → saved → reloaded → restored to Template 3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The demo tenant now carries three cosmetic TEST shops left over from this iteration and iteration 15 (TEST shop 48b7e9, TEST shop 4cacd4 renamed, TEST shop 64c583 renamed) and one TEST bank account (TEST Bank Iter15). All are non-dormant and empty. Treat them as noise — the shop API has no DELETE by design. Owner demo invariants: plan pro/monthly, currency NGN, Ikeja branch is main+active, invoice template 'Template 3'. For PO lifecycle tests: PO-449 was created as a cancelled TEST order (TEST_Sup_6fa258, 2 × Adeba Rice 50kg at ₦1,000) and is intentionally cancelled so a next run can hit the cancelled-view path. To reach a live purchase from the UI, go through /suppliers/{sid} — there is no /purchases list screen (/purchases returns 'Unmatched Route'). Templates test needs to tap templates-pick-t<N> (NOT template-card-N) and then templates-save (NOT templates-save-top which lives in the header).
rca_of_issue: All six user complaints are resolved. (2) Invoice action row: /invoices/[id].tsx now branches on status + balance — a DRAFT renders invoice-record-payment that only toasts and invoice-issue-shortcut that opens invoice-issue-sheet, an ISSUED unpaid invoice renders invoice-record-payment that navigates to /payments/new and a Send reminder button, a PAID invoice renders 'Record another payment' + Send receipt + invoice-paid-note. (3) PO edit/cancel: new PUT /api/purchases/{pid} re-lays stock (reverse-then-apply so edit 1→2 nets +1), POST /{pid}/cancel reverses stock and uses LIVE_PO to drop the PO from supplier_owed, purchases list and item supply history, POST /{pid}/uncancel restores. UI /purchases/[id].tsx renders purchase-edit (route /purchases/new?edit=<id>) + purchase-cancel (opens purchase-cancel-sheet), the cancelled state swaps to purchase-restore + purchase-cancelled-note. (4) Shops edit+dormant: PUT /api/shops/{name} renames every record via SHOP_FIELDS mapping, POST /{name}/dormant with the three guards (main branch, last working, dormant=false reopens); UI shows shop-edit-<name> and the inline shop-dormant button inside the edit sheet. (5a) Accounts edit+dormant: PUT /api/accounts/{aid} + POST /{aid}/dormant with 'only live account' guard; UI reuses account-add-sheet with 'Save changes' + 'Make dormant'. (5b) Team edit+dormant: PUT /api/team/{uid} accepts name+phone, POST /{uid}/dormant flips `active`, login() rejects inactive 403; UI /team/[id].tsx has member-name, member-phone, member-dormant and the dead Remove button is gone. (6) Templates: templates-pick-tN sets selection, templates-save POSTs settings/invoice-template, reload confirms persistence; invoice-paper.tsx Simple = narrow 80mm paper-receipt (dashed rules, caps shop name, no bank block, no image column), Professional = A4 full invoice (dark item table, image column when photos on, bank details). Two look clearly different.
